_comment: INDUSTRIAL: an exposed conduit run - a pipe on three clamp saddles with a joint flange amidships. Plumbing on the OUTSIDE of the hull is the whole thesis of this kit: a working ship routes its services where a fitter can reach them. Like the hazard band it raises its footprint budget to 0.92 of a cell and lies along +Z, so consecutive plates of one run come out as a CONTINUOUS pipe rather than as a row of short stubs - which is the only way a conduit reads as a conduit.
